results.title: Sim-to-real transfer with offline domain randomization
results.content: # DROPO: Sim-to-real transfer with offline domain randomization. Robot policies trained with DROPO can efficiently transfer to the real world. In recent years, domain randomization over dynamics parameters has gained a lot of traction as a method for sim-to-real transfer of reinforcement learning policies in robotic manipulation; however, finding optimal randomization distributions can be difficult. In this paper, we introduce DROPO, a novel method for estimating domain randomization distributions for safe sim-to-real transfer.
